🔥 OSINT-Framework | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a centralized, easily navigable directory of free open-source intelligence (OSINT) tools and resources for information gathering and analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Curated list of free OSINT tools and resources • Categorization by type and use case • Support for online and locally installed tools
📖 Summary: The OSINT Framework is a curated collection of free tools and resources designed to aid in information gathering and intelligence analysis. It categorizes resources by type and use case, making it easier for users to find relevant tools for reconnaissance, footprinting, and other OSINT tasks, with options for both online and locally installed tools.
